entities.summary: Julie de Cistello, or Julie de la Bourdonnay Cistello, known as Vicomtesse de Sistelo was a Portuguese-Brazilian impressionist painter in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, a pioneer in women's access to art education, and one of the first Portuguese-Brazilian women artists in the annual Parisian Salons. Her name in Portuguese is Júlia Labourdonnay Gonçalves Roque.
